channel.title: Engine changes | CitedBy
channel.description: Dated changes from Google, Bing and Lighthouse that affect how sites are found and cited, each read on the engine's own page, with what to do and whether CitedBy checks it.

item.title: The Search generative AI control rolls out to all sites worldwide
item.description:
Open Settings > Search generative AI in Search Console and confirm each property is set to include the site, unless the owner chose otherwise.

What CitedBy checks: Not checked. The setting lives in Search Console and CitedBy cannot see it.

Source: https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/16908024

item.title: Generative AI performance reports roll out to all sites worldwide
item.description:
Check the Generative AI performance report is now visible for every property, in every country you serve.

What CitedBy checks: Not read. Same as the launch entry: CitedBy does not read this report.

Source: https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2026/06/gen-ai-performance-reports

item.title: Google launches AI Overviews and AI Mode in France
item.description:
Read the French AI impressions in the Generative AI performance report and check which French questions now show an AI Overview.

What CitedBy checks: Not checked. CitedBy does not measure whether a question shows an AI Overview.

Source: https://blog.google/intl/fr-fr/nouveautes-produits/explorez-obtenez-des-reponses/recherche-ia-apercus-mode/

item.title: Google says llms.txt is not needed for Search
item.description:
Keep llms.txt optional: publish it for other tools if wanted, but do not expect Google Search visibility from it.

What CitedBy checks: Checked. A missing llms.txt shows as an optional notice, never an error, because no major assistant is confirmed to read it.

Source: https://developers.google.com/search/updates

item.title: Search Console launches Generative AI performance reports
item.description:
Open the Generative AI performance report in Search Console and read AI impressions by page, country and device.

What CitedBy checks: Not read. The Search Console connection checks which pages Google has indexed; the Generative AI report is read in Search Console itself.

Source: https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2026/06/gen-ai-performance-reports

item.title: Google Analytics adds a channel for AI assistant traffic
item.description:
Open the Default Channel Group in GA4 reports, check that the AI Assistant channel shows, and add a custom rule only for AI referrers that still land in Referral.

What CitedBy checks: Not checked. CitedBy reads your pages, not your analytics.

Source: https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9164320

item.title: Lighthouse adds an agentic browsing category with an llms.txt audit
item.description:
Make /llms.txt answer 200 or 404, never a server error: Lighthouse flags server errors on it and marks a 404 Not Applicable.

What CitedBy checks: Partly. Every crawl requests /llms.txt: 200 counts as present, 404 or 410 as missing (an optional notice). CitedBy does not flag a server error on it as an issue.

Source: https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse/releases/tag/v13.3.0

item.title: Search Console's branded queries filter reaches all eligible sites
item.description:
In the Search Console Performance report, apply the branded and non-branded filter and read the two groups separately.

What CitedBy checks: Not checked. It changes how you read Search Console, not how your pages are built.

Source: https://developers.google.com/search/blog/2025/11/search-console-branded-filter

item.title: Bing adds AI Performance to Webmaster Tools (public preview)
item.description:
Verify the site in Bing Webmaster Tools, open AI Performance and export citations, cited pages and grounding queries each month.

What CitedBy checks: Not read. With a Bing Webmaster Tools API key CitedBy shows how many pages Bing holds, the sitemap's state and crawl errors; the AI Performance report is read in Bing Webmaster Tools itself.

Source: https://blogs.bing.com/webmaster/2026/2/Introducing-AI-Performance-in-Bing-Webmaster-Tools-Public-Preview/
